title: Ricoh GR IV High-End Compact Camera
purpose: Decisive 28mm snap street photography with deep zone-focus acutance, punchy high contrast, gritty urban texture, and spontaneous pocketable framing.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: Ricoh GR IV Compact Camera (25.7MP APS-C)
sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 25.7MP APS-C CMOS sensor with zero optical low-pass filter
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: 28mm wide-angle street snapshot field of view
sensor_and_optics.lens: GR Lens 18.3mm f/2.8 (28mm equivalent fixed prime)
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: ISO 200 base sensitivity with gritty high-ISO street character
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 14 stops dynamic range with high-contrast monochrome or positive film tone
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Leaf shutter up to 1/4000s, whisper-quiet snap focus actuation

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Dynamic urban daylight or high-contrast street shadows, available city light
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Deep gritty contrast, punchy black levels, crisp specular edge acutance

surface_rendering: Razor-sharp 28mm zone focus: resolved asphalt texture, peeling paint, fabric weave, and urban grime
Punchy high micro-contrast without artificial edge haloes or smeary denoise
Authentic street documentary grit and honest human skin texture
depth_and_optics: Deep zone focus from foreground to background at f/5.6
Immaculate flat field with zero barrel distortion across the 28mm field of view
Spontaneous, dynamic candid street framing from hip level or eye level

execution_directive: Enforce 28mm wide street snapshot from a pocket camera, close quarters, deep zone focus, punchy high contrast, gritty texture, slightly spontaneous framing, shot on Ricoh GR IV.
